description: Gemini CLI agent integration, built in to the application.
configuration.title: Gemini
configuration.cli.version: The version of GeminiCode's own copy of the Gemini CLI to run, such as `0.62.0`. When empty, the newest copy is used. Ignored when `#gemini.cliPath#` is set, and `gemini` on `PATH` is used when no copy is installed.
configuration.cliPath: Path to the Gemini CLI. Either a `gemini` executable or the CLI's JavaScript entry point (run with the application's bundled Node). When empty, GeminiCode's own copy is used (see `#gemini.cli.version#`), or else `gemini` on `PATH`.
viewContainer.title: Gemini
command.installCliVersion: Install or Change Gemini CLI Version...
configuration.projectId: Google Cloud project ID the agent bills to, passed to the CLI as `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`. Use the project ID, not the project number. A workspace value wins over a user value; when neither is set, the organisation default and then the `GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT`, `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` and `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` environment variables are used.

configuration.layout.showAgentsInNewWork: Show the Agents pane and the Changes view the first time a workspace opens. Afterwards the layout you arrange is kept.
